question: What tool do we use to cut a piece of paper? ✂️
explanation: Awesome! We carefully use a pair of scissors to cut paper into fun shapes! ✂️

question: What do we use to write neat letters in our notebook? ✏️
explanation: Great job! A pencil helps us write and draw beautiful pictures! ✏️

question: What do we use to clean up a pencil mistake? 🧼
explanation: Super! An eraser rubs away mistakes so we can try again! 🧼
hint: It is soft and made of rubber.

question: Which tool helps us draw straight lines? 📏
explanation: Fantastic! A ruler helps us measure and draw perfectly straight lines! 📏

question: What do we use to stick two pieces of paper together? 🧴
explanation: Brilliant! Glue is sticky and helps hold our paper crafts together! 🧴
hint: It comes in a bottle or stick.

question: What do we use to color a lovely picture? 🖍️
explanation: Awesome! Colorful crayons make our drawings look bright and happy! 🖍️
hint: They come in many beautiful colors.

question: What object helps us keep our pencils sharp? 🖍️
explanation: Great job! A sharpener makes the tip of our pencil pointy and ready to write! 🖍️

question: Where do we safely keep our pencils and erasers? 🧃
explanation: Super! A pencil box keeps all our small writing tools safe in one place! 🧃
hint: You open it to find your stationery.

question: What do we carry our school books in? 🎒
explanation: Fantastic! We wear a school bag on our back to carry our heavy books safely! 🎒
hint: It has straps for your shoulders.

question: What do we use to read wonderful stories? 📖
explanation: Brilliant! A book has pages filled with words and pictures for us to read! 📖
hint: It has a cover and many pages.

question: What tool is best for eating hot soup? 🥄
explanation: Awesome! A spoon looks like a little bowl and is perfect for scooping up soup! 🥄

question: What do we use to easily eat long noodles? 🍴
explanation: Great job! A fork has little points to help us pick up noodles and pasta! 🍴

question: What do we use to drink yummy milk? 🥛
explanation: Super! We pour our tasty milk into a glass to drink it easily! 🥛
hint: It is tall and holds drinks.

question: Where do we serve sweet pudding or rice? 🥣
explanation: Fantastic! A bowl is nice and deep to hold our favorite foods! 🥣

question: What sharp tool do adults use to cut vegetables? 🔪
explanation: Brilliant! Adults carefully use a sharp knife to chop vegetables for cooking! 🔪
hint: It has a sharp edge. Kids should not touch it.

question: What machine keeps our food cold and fresh? 🧊
explanation: Awesome! The fridge is a cool machine that stops our food from going bad! 🧊

question: What do we use to wipe our messy mouth after eating? 🧻
explanation: Great job! A soft napkin helps keep our face and hands clean while eating! 🧻
hint: It is a small piece of cloth or paper.

question: What do we use to clean our teeth every morning? 🪥
explanation: Super! A toothbrush keeps our teeth shiny and healthy! 🪥

question: What do we use to wash our dirty hands? 🧼
explanation: Fantastic! Soap makes lovely bubbles and washes away all the invisible germs! 🧼

question: What do we use to make our messy hair look neat? 🪮
explanation: Brilliant! A comb gently untangles our hair and makes us look smart! 🪮

question: What do we use to dry our body after a bath? 🛁
explanation: Awesome! A big, soft towel soaks up the water and dries us off! 🛁
hint: It is made of soft cloth.

question: What tool helps us sweep dust off the floor? 🧹
explanation: Great job! A broom sweeps all the dust and dirt away to keep our house clean! 🧹

question: What machine washes our dirty clothes? 👕
explanation: Super! The washing machine spins with soap and water to clean our clothes! 👕

question: Where should we always throw our empty chips packets? 🗑️
explanation: Fantastic! Using a dustbin keeps our surroundings clean and beautiful! 🗑️
hint: It is a bin for rubbish.

question: What do we use to see our own face? 🪞
explanation: Brilliant! A mirror reflects light so we can see exactly what we look like! 🪞
hint: It is made of shiny glass.

question: What helps us tell the correct time? ⏰
explanation: Awesome! A clock has hands that move to show us the hours and minutes! ⏰

question: What machine helps us talk to people far away? 📱
explanation: Great job! A phone lets us hear our friends' voices even when they are far! 📱

question: What machine do we use to watch fun cartoons? 📺
explanation: Super! The TV shows us moving pictures and plays sound for us to enjoy! 📺

question: What machine keeps our room cool in hot summer? 🪭
explanation: Fantastic! A fan spins very fast to blow cool air around the room! 🪭

question: What gives us bright light in a dark room? 💡
explanation: Brilliant! A light bulb shines brightly so we can see when the sun goes down! 💡

question: What heavy tool is used to push a nail into wood? 🔨
explanation: Awesome! A strong hammer is used to hit nails safely into place! 🔨
hint: It is heavy and goes bang-bang.

question: What sharp tool is used with thread to sew clothes? 🪡
explanation: Great job! A needle has a tiny hole for the thread to sew pieces of cloth! 🪡

question: What small metal object opens a locked door? 🔑
explanation: Super! We put the correct key into the lock and turn it to open the door! 🔑
hint: You turn it in the lock.

question: What do we use to see clearly outside in the dark? 🔦
explanation: Fantastic! A torch runs on batteries and shines a strong beam of light! 🔦
hint: You hold it in your hand to see.

question: Which vehicle has two wheels and pedals? 🚲
explanation: Brilliant! A bicycle is a healthy way to travel using our own leg power! 🚲

question: Which vehicle travels fast across the water? ⛵
explanation: Awesome! Boats float and carry people safely across rivers and lakes! ⛵

question: Which vehicle flies very high up in the sky? ✈️
explanation: Great job! Airplanes have wings and fly people far away very quickly! ✈️

question: Which long vehicle moves smoothly on iron tracks? 🚆
explanation: Super! Trains have many compartments and run chug-chug on long railway tracks! 🚆

question: Which big yellow vehicle takes children to school? 🚌
explanation: Fantastic! A school bus is safe and fun for traveling to school with friends! 🚌

question: Which vehicle rushes sick people to the hospital? 🚑
explanation: Brilliant! An ambulance has a loud siren to clear the road and help sick people! 🚑
hint: It has a red cross and a loud siren.

question: Which big red vehicle rushes to put out fires? 🚒
explanation: Awesome! Fire engines carry brave firefighters and lots of water to stop fires! 🚒
hint: It is red and has a ladder.

question: Which strong vehicle helps a farmer in the fields? 🚜
explanation: Great job! A tractor has big wheels and pulls heavy tools to help grow crops! 🚜
hint: It is used on a farm.

question: Which vehicle travels super fast to outer space? 🚀
explanation: Super! Rockets have powerful engines to blast off all the way to the stars! 🚀

question: Which vehicle carries very heavy boxes on the road? 🚚
explanation: Fantastic! A strong truck has a big space in the back to carry heavy things! 🚚
hint: It is bigger than a car.

question: What object helps us stay dry in the rainy season? ☔
explanation: Brilliant! An umbrella opens up like a roof to keep the rain off our heads! ☔
hint: You hold it up when it rains.

question: What do we use to drink fresh water when we are thirsty? 🚰
explanation: Awesome! We pour cool, clean water into a glass to drink it easily! 🚰

question: What do we open to let fresh air into our room? 🪟
explanation: Great job! A window lets in sunlight and lovely fresh breezes! 🪟
hint: It has glass and is on the wall.

question: What machine takes beautiful pictures of us? 📷
explanation: Super! A camera clicks and saves memories so we can see them later! 📷

question: What object has keys to help us type on a computer? ⌨️
explanation: Fantastic! A keyboard has many little buttons with letters to help us type words! ⌨️
hint: It has ABC and 123 on it.

question: What small object helps us point and click on a computer? 🖱️
explanation: Brilliant! A computer mouse fits perfectly in our hand to help us click things! 🖱️
hint: It shares its name with an animal.
